input: One line with five values separated by single spaces: an \texttt{int}, a \texttt{long long}, a \texttt{char}, a \texttt{float} and a \texttt{double}, in this order.
output: Print the five values, each on its own line, in the order they were given. Print them with \texttt{cout} without changing its default formatting, and do not print extra spaces.
notes: Printing a \texttt{double} with \texttt{cout} shows at most 6 significant digits by default, so 14049.30493 is printed as 14049.3.
